title: India Ranks 80th on Henley Passport Index 2026
summary: Indian passport holders gain visa-free/on-arrival access to 55 destinations, moving up 5 spots to 80th globally.

blocks.content: India climbed 5 positions to rank **80th globally on Henley Passport Index 2026**, offering visa-free/eTA access to **55 destinations**.

items: **Top Rank**: Singapore ranks 1st for 3rd consecutive year (192 destinations).
